results.title: Land of the Dead: It's for the gays
results.original_title: Land of the Dead: It's for the gays
results.overview: A dark, camp-infused comedy about Mel, a non-binary person coming to terms with their identity. Much to their dismay, Evy ropes them into a Samhain retreat with their friends Remy, Tyler, and Sage. All Hades breaks loose when a demon from Mel's past returns to haunt them all after a seance goes awry. Mel is confronted by the demon they accidentally summoned in childhood - a manifestation of fear, shame, and unresolved identity. While their friends navigate their own Queer expressions through drag makeup, chaotic flirtations, and substance-fueled denial, Mel’s journey unfolds more subtly.

results.title: The Whistling Game
results.overview: A woman searching for her missing brother travels into the wilderness of Dartmoor, England, documenting her investigation as she follows the trail he left behind. As her search deepens, she encounters an ancient mystery, while her camera captures increasingly inexplicable events.

results.title: The Cull
results.overview: Wrongly imprisoned for his mother’s murder, Niall is finally released, having found God and renounced a life of violence and addiction. Retreating to a remote woodland cabin seeking redemption and the truth behind her death, he finds a hostile community ruled by a ruthless family, where every encounter deepens the mystery surrounding his mother’s past. As brutal violence erupts and terrifying visions blur the line between nightmare and reality, Niall uncovers a sinister legacy of witchcraft, blood sacrifice and forbidden ritual. Something has been patiently waiting in the forest, and its hunger for vengeance can only be satisfied with blood.

results.title: Two Rivers
results.overview: Near the Oder River, where Poland and Germany meet, the two friends Szymon and Franek spend every free moment at the skatepark. A place where everyone comes together, regardless of where they come from.  But as they look across to the other side of the river, their perception begins to shift. The river becomes a border, fences cut through the space, appearing and disappearing again.  Shot on 16mm, this short combines documentary observation and animation and follows two children growing up at a borderland who begin to question what borders really are: something tangible, like the river they are looking at, or something that exists only in their imagination?

results.title: RIP ME, LOL
results.overview: After a leaked sex tape drives her to suicide, Megan returns as a vengeful ghost haunting the men who wronged her.

results.title: Minä ja Riikka Purra
results.overview: This film was not anticipated. “My motive for making the documentary 'Me and Riikka Purra' was curiosity,” says the screenwriter-director, who first gained recognition as a musician and producer. “I realized that I didn’t know a single ‘Persu’ [Finns Party supporter], nor did I understand their way of thinking. I wanted to find out!”

results.title: The Birthday​ Gift​
results.overview: Single mother Marlene Frischmann organizes a birthday party for her son Theo at her brother's chic country villa, which quickly spirals into family drama, world-view quarrels, and chaos.

results.title: Singgaramm
results.overview: An ordinary man finds himself cornered by a world that demands his surrender. Refusing to bow down, he summons the courage to stand his ground and sets out on a path that will rewrite his destiny.

results.title: Plastic Love!
results.overview: A pop-infused dive into Japan's love of packaging―and how it might hold the key to escaping a plastic-wrapped future.

results.title: The Night That Binds Us
results.overview: A lone student in Shanghai, struggling with family problems, finds romance with a middle-aged dorm manager.

results.title: Hard Stuff
results.overview: The band "Noble Rot" is preparing for a concert at the Secret Place.

results.title: vortex
results.overview: the film observes four symbols near the Bessarabsky Market in Kyiv.

results.title: Cedar Bluff
results.overview: Pregnant and desperate to escape her dead-end life, a small-town girl falls for a reckless robber and joins his crime spree, only to discover that the freedom she craved comes at a devastating cost.

results.title: Forever Young
results.overview: The direct aftermath of a gang run-in, where a boy tries to convince his severely injured friend to stay alive.

results.title: Twincredible!
results.overview: With the final innings of the 1991 World Series buzzing through their television set, this portrait of struggling new parents Bert and Annette unfolds over one night in their half-finished home, where an argument stirs emotions neither of them fully understand.

results.title: Gracie Sees a Ghost
results.overview: A documentary investigating a family annihilation case and the enigma of its perpetrator, Gracie Donaghue.

results.title: The Foreboding
results.overview: On a final walk with her terminally ill mother, the filmmaker sees a blossoming tree so beautiful that she says she would like to be one herself. After a long silence, her mother gives only one reply: “When?” Made only a few days before her mother’s death, the film is a poetic and uncompromising essay on farewell.
